name: stands
description: A seat at the game, in the park it's played in. A room carrying flags.stands sells seats by section, each with a price and an eye in the 3-D view's frame; `stands` shows the chart, `stands <section>` buys a seat and opens the rink or the park in first person from it, following the play or free-looking, and `stands leave` (or walking out) gets you up. A seat is a receiver: it tunes the player to the channel carrying that sport's game through the Tablet TV's per-player path, so nothing here simulates anything. Tickets are items (tickets.js): one seat at one game, bought at a box office, a seat door or the seat (`buyticket`, `stands <section>`), sat on with `stands ticket <id>`, which tears the stub. It also keeps the last champion for a Cup room's display (champions.js) and runs the ice crew's routine at each intermission (crew.js).
